    assignment = []

    return assignment


def compute_cohens_kappa(labels_a, labels_b):
    """Compute Cohen's kappa between two binary label arrays."""
    a = np.array(labels_a, dtype=int)
    b = np.array(labels_b, dtype=int)
    n = len(a)
    assert len(b) == n

    # 2x2 contingency
    n11 = np.sum((a == 1) & (b == 1))
    n00 = np.sum((a == 0) & (b == 0))
    n10 = np.sum((a == 1) & (b == 0))
    n01 = np.sum((a == 0) & (b == 1))

    p_o = (n11 + n00) / n
    p_a1 = (n11 + n10) / n
    p_b1 = (n11 + n01) / n
    p_a0 = (n00 + n01) / n
    p_b0 = (n00 + n10) / n
    p_e = p_a1 * p_b1 + p_a0 * p_b0

    if p_e == 1.0:
        return 1.0 if p_o == 1.0 else 0.0
    return (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e)
